snippet.title: No Asteroids | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Dig away a 5,000,000 m³ asteroid in first person before it hits Earth. It comes out on Steam on November 24.
Add it to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527800/

An asteroid of 5,000,000 m³ will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself.

You are that miner. Every day you fly down and dig while your air lasts. Back on the ship you sell the ore, and a capsule takes it to Earth. Then you buy bigger tools and guns. A big counter shows how many m³ are left. On the first day it hardly moves. Later your ship fires at the rock while you dig, and the number goes down much faster.

The game is for Windows and macOS, in 12 languages. It is singleplayer, and the main contract takes about 6 to 9 hours.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527800/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/noasteroids/
Contact: hello@unruledgames.com

#NoAsteroids #IndieGame #Steam
